customerPromise: Return the highest-scoring legal team found in the complete admitted strategy space for one exact, expiring Splinterlands match snapshot.

request.account: canonical Hive account or anonymous customer identifier
request.matchSnapshotDigest: digest binding format, mana cap, rules, inactive elements, league, and protocol version
request.inventorySnapshotDigest: digest binding owned or explicitly rentable card instances
request.expiresAt: timestamp before the match submission deadline

response.team: archon UID, ordered unit UIDs, and ally color
response.score: objective value under the named objective version
response.candidateCount: number of admitted strategies exhaustively evaluated
response.legalityWitness: evidence that the returned team satisfies every supplied constraint
response.dominanceWitness: evidence that no admitted candidate has a higher score

commercialBoundary.launchAccount: dedicated Hive account to be named only after demand validation
commercialBoundary.offerDiscovery: signed Hive publication or custom_json announcing objective versions and prices
commercialBoundary.settlement: priced boundary receipt; HBD is the preferred initial unit
commercialBoundary.delivery: encrypted direct response or authenticated off-chain response whose digest is anchored on Hive
commercialBoundary.custody: inference-only; the service never receives customer posting or active keys

claimsExcluded: The recommendation does not promise a battle win.
Dominance is relative to the supplied snapshot, admitted strategy carrier, and versioned objective.
Opponent uncertainty and hidden information remain explicit model inputs rather than proof conclusions.
nextEvidence: Bind the live TypeScript enumerator output to the Lean recommendation carrier.
Version an expected-value objective from replay and opponent-history data.
Measure recommendation latency and realized rating or reward lift on michael561.
Validate willingness to pay before creating or funding a dedicated Hive account.
